title: Slice 554749: Inventory put-away/pick support for subcontracting purchase lines and WIP item transfers
summary: Inventory put-away and pick functionality is now supported for subcontracting purchase lines and WIP item transfers, with proper handling of quantities, item tracking, bin propagation, and partial posting scenarios.
key_points: Enables warehouse put-away/pick operations for subcontracting purchase orders and WIP transfers
Preserves correct base quantities and production-order item tracking for last-operation lines
Non-last-operation and WIP movements bypass physical inventory posting and synchronize WIP ledger entries
Supports lot tracking, partial posting, direct transfers, blank-bin locations, and posted activity metadata
Adds extension points via new base warehouse events
quote: Adds inventory put-away/pick support for subcontracting purchase lines and WIP item transfers.
